messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a weekday (Monday–Thursday) and therefore extends the weekend to three consecutive days (Friday–Sunday or Monday–Wednesday).  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, MB, ON, SK, NB) | Feb 20 | Monday | ✔️ | Creates a Mon‑Sun long weekend. |
| **Good Friday** (nationwide) | Apr 7 | Friday | ✔️ | Creates a Fri‑Sun long weekend. |
| **Victoria Day** (nationwide) | May 22 | Monday | ✔️ | Creates a Mon‑Sun long weekend. |
| **Civic Holiday** (most provinces, except QC) | Aug 7 | Monday | ✔️ | Creates a Mon‑Sun long weekend. |
| **Labour Day** (nationwide) | Sep 4 | Monday | ✔️ | Creates a Mon‑Sun long weekend. |
| **Thanksgiving** (nationwide) | Oct 10 | Monday | ✔️ | Creates a Mon‑Sun long weekend. |
| **Christmas** (nationwide) | Dec 25 | Monday | ✔️ | Creates a Mon‑Sun long weekend. |

### Holidays that did **not** create a long weekend in 2023

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Reason |
|---------|-------------|-------------|--------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Already a weekend day. |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Falls on a weekend; no extra day off. |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Thursday | Falls on a weekday but no adjacent holiday. |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | Falls on a weekday but no adjacent holiday. |

> **Provinces & Territories** – Some holidays above (e.g., Family Day, Civic Holiday) are observed only in certain provinces/territories. If your app needs province‑specific data, you’ll need to filter accordingly.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same information broken down by province or if you need additional details (e.g., alternative observance dates when holidays fall on weekends).
